items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: I was a Fred Astaire freak. So I’d walk two miles... and go see Fred Astaire in South Fork, Pennsylvania, just so I could try to learn those songs.

ctx.x: This one? I have a whole new thing on this, with the bass. I do a whole thing on this with all dance tunes, dedicated to Fred Astaire. Bass and voice. Yeah. It’s never been recorded yet. But I will record it one day.
I hope so. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
